notes.title: The release version of Cat's Kiss is now available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39784093/3d41b8d180cd984648f3b4137953f185e6dbec2a.jpg

Hello, all followers.

After a year of adjustments and updates, Cat's Kiss: Cat Research is now officially released. Thank you to all the players who have tried out the game and provided many suggestions to make this release.

If you encounter any problems with the game, or if you encounter difficulties, we recommend you browse the forums or the guide first.

Last but not least, we would like to give you some suggestions for purchasing.
In addition to the erotic content, this game also places a lot of emphasis on the "daily interactions between two people", so there is no way to have crazy sex right from the start. If you are still considering it, you may want to check out the negative and positive reviews in the comments section.

In the future, we are expecting a major update, mainly with the addition of an "Extra Mode".
So, we hope you enjoy this work!

notes.title: Update notes and plan-4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
In the version just pushed, we have made the following updates.

1. Fixed the bug affecting non-English/Chinese locales where players were becoming stuck after the prologue.
2. Fixed the problem of the "attack" beginning plot that has been reversed.
3. Fixed the expression when the normal position is successfully inserted during anal for the first time.
4. From the night of the second day onward, if the heroine wakes up you will no longer go back to the title screen.

5. Cat mode!!
On the eighth day of the game, you can now experience "cat mode!" There are corresponding images, interactions and prop effects.

In the future, our goal is to allow players to freely choose between human and cat modes. However, there are important plot points that would be missing if in cat mode, so we need to solve this problem first.
We hope you will enjoy this update.

In the next update, we expect to:
1. Add some new dialogue.
2. Adjust the background story to prepare for the player being able to switch freely between human and cat mode.

notes.title: Update frequency description
notes.notes:
(Hint: the solution to not being able to progress after the first dialog is at the bottom)

Hello everyone,
Thank you for liking our work this time. We have received many bug reports in the past few days, so I would like to explain to you our current plan:

In the short-term, we will prioritize fixing bugs in the current game. In terms of new content, we will add some events to remind players that their favorability/interest has reached the next level.

For example, XiangLi might mention that she wants her own room, suggesting that she might do something... that she can do when she is alone.

Before substantially updating more content, we must ensure that the basic content is stable in order to avoid facing a huge, illegally  constructed building that is about to collapse. In addition, we must first merge the English and Chinese versions into one Build to save the time that we will need to update the game in the future (currently, each language is a separate build).

Thank you,

notes.title: Cat's Kiss will launch an early access version on 05/31
notes.notes:
Hello, followers
Cat's Kiss will launch an Early Access version on 05/31. The pre-order price is USD$14.99, and there will be a 10% discount for a limited time.
If you want to know why we chose "Early Access", please click this news.

This is the first time our team will support English at launch. Although it is very hard, we are trying our best. Thanks to Bluemist, Ureminex, Dot, Oli Jan, Alone, and JS Chen for their assistance.

Tomorrow we will introduce to you the content included in this version.
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Notice of Store Page Update
notes.notes:
(This news is for Japanese players, English content is translated by DeepL free version)

Thank you for taking notice of our work.
As of today's update, the store page is now available in Japanese.

We are also working on the language support for the game itself.
At this stage, we have decided to support Chinese and English.
However, we are still considering Japanese language support.

We would like to support Japanese for this game, but unfortunately
Narrator is an indie game club, so we don't always have the funds to do so.
I'm considering translating it to DeepL and using reviewers to control the quality.
In the meantime, I'd like to support Japanese from the store page.

If you have any comments about the store content, translation, or reviews
Please leave a message.
